Name: Elliott's Extensive Marriage Dialogue
Author: Drorie
Description:
[b][color=#dbb0a7][size=4] ﻿FEATURES:[/size][/color][/b]

﻿-[color=#b6d7a8]This mod replaces all of Elliott’s marriage dialogue lines with way more dialogue lines.[/color] This is to make him feel more alive.

﻿-He will even give you a prize he won after the Fair!

-[color=#b6d7a8]This mod also contains suggestive lines.[/color] If this isn’t your cup of tea, this may not be the mod for you. I plan to make a version without these lines however after some beta testing has happened.

[b][color=#dbb0a7][size=4]INSTILLATION:[/size][/color][/b]

-Download the Zip File and extract it.

-[color=#b6d7a8]This mod requires Content Patcher,[/color] ideally the latest version; (Content Patcher 2.3.0) All other versions are compatible, the log will just behave a little abnormally.

-[color=#b6d7a8]Make sure this is the only Elliott Marriage Dialogue you are using![/color] Dialogue mods tend to overwrite each other and you could lose a lot of what Elliott has to say.

[b][color=#dbb0a7][size=4]DISCLAIMER: [/size][/color][/b]

-[color=#b6d7a8]The mod is in its beta phase as of now.[/color] Upon future releases, festival dialogue will be added. If there are any hiccups or mistakes within the dialogue, please report it. I want this mod to be as good as it can be.

[b]﻿Special thanks to everyone on tumblr who helped inspire this mod![/b]

Downloads.Description: Added gender neutral dialogue option, as well as a bunch of code/grammar fixes.
